reason: translator-bug: real Marko rejects a lowercase local-variable tag reference outright ("Local variables must be in a dynamic tag unless they are PascalCase. Use `<${layout}/>` or rename to `Layout`.") -- verified against @marko/compiler 5.42.5 / marko@6.3.51. @markox/translator's isComponent (translate.ts) is binding-based regardless of case, so it calls the import successfully instead of erroring. The translator is strictly MORE permissive than Marko here; decision 67 says the translator should follow Marko, so this divergence should be closed by making isComponent reject a lowercase local-variable reference the same way Marko does.
